name: Sports Toto Berhad
summary: Sports Toto Berhad, an investment holding company, operates Toto betting in Malaysia, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. The company engages in gaming and lottery management, luxury motor retailing, hospitality, and environmental services. The company offers luxury and pre-owned vehicle retailing, aftersales services, insurance services, hotel operations, waste management and environmental services, computerized wagering systems, software licensing, and related support services. The company was formerly known as Berjaya Sports Toto Berhad and changed its name to Sports Toto Berhad in April 2022. Sports Toto Berhad was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
